english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for winning a game, battle, prize, or contest.
Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice when “prevail” means to win or triumph.
Use this when framing the result from the winner's side, as in beating someone in a game or contest.
Use this for prevailing or winning against someone in a contest, conflict, or other competition.
